extends: 6V6_TRACK_HOLD_DOSE_PILOT_V1.json (separate seed block -- NOT a continuation of it)
AUTHORITY: PI 2026-09-12, verbatim: '6v6 severe stale-track extension, exploratory. Evaluate the frozen Share-Encoder controller separately under z0 and z1 at K in {0,4,5,6}, where K Red tracks are frozen at their t=0 positions. Use a fresh, disjoint 20-seed block. For each seed, draw one deterministic Red-agent permutation and construct nested held sets K4 subset K5 subset K6, identical across both strategy codes. Re-evaluate K=0 on the same fresh seeds so all severe-dose losses L_K(z) = V_0(z) - V_K(z) are paired within the new block. Report each strategy code separately.'
WHY_THIS_IS_A_NEW_SEVERITY_QUESTION_NOT_: The pre-specified K<=3 pilot produced a CEILING, not a null worth resampling: z1 won 20/20 at every dose and not one of its 60 degraded episodes changed outcome. That is structural evidence the tested dose range was too weak to reach a breakdown, and it is a reason to probe the untested half of a bounded dose axis. It is explicitly NOT 'add samples until the old null becomes significant' -- no seed is added at K=1,2,3, and the pilot's result stands exactly as sealed.

THESE_ARE_TWO_BLOCKS_NOT_ONE_CURVE.rule: The K=1,2,3 pilot (seeds 13700001-13700020) and this K=4,5,6 extension (seeds 13710001-13710020) use DIFFERENT seeds. They are two separate exploratory experiments.
THESE_ARE_TWO_BLOCKS_NOT_ONE_CURVE.pilot_L_K_baseline: paired against the pilot's own K=0 on 13700001-020
THESE_ARE_TWO_BLOCKS_NOT_ONE_CURVE.extension_L_K_baseline: paired against THIS block's own K=0 on 13710001-020
THESE_ARE_TWO_BLOCKS_NOT_ONE_CURVE.permitted: showing both descriptively in one table or figure, with the block boundary marked
THESE_ARE_TWO_BLOCKS_NOT_ONE_CURVE.forbidden: drawing one smooth inferential curve through K=0..6 as though every dose used identical seeds; any paired statistic that crosses the block boundary
THESE_ARE_TWO_BLOCKS_NOT_ONE_CURVE.a_matched_full_axis_experiment_would_cos: 2 codes x 7 doses x 20 seeds = 280 fresh episodes; deliberately NOT spent

CHECKPOINT.what_it_is: the frozen 6v6 Share-Encoder (Rung-1) latent-conditioned controller -- identical to the pilot's checkpoint, unmodified
CHECKPOINT.verified_at_runtime: the evaluator recomputes this sha256 and refuses to run on mismatch

DESIGN.codes: z0 and z1, reported SEPARATELY, never collapsed
DESIGN.K_meaning: K Red tracks frozen at their true t=0 position for the remainder of the episode; K=6 means Blue's entire picture of Red is stale
DESIGN.nesting: K4 subset K5 subset K6, from ONE deterministic permutation per seed: rng = default_rng(seed + 900001); perm = permutation(6); K_k = perm[:k]
DESIGN.K0_rerun_on_this_block: REQUIRED -- L_K must be paired within this block

POWER_DISCLOSED_BEFORE_RUNNING: n=20 detects only gross breakdowns. A drop from 1.00 to ~0.70 would show clearly; 1.00 to 0.90 would not reliably. This experiment can locate WHERE performance breaks, not precisely HOW MUCH it degrades. Stated here, before the result exists, so the limitation cannot later be presented as a discovery.

PRECOMMITTED_INTERPRETATION.strong_drop_at_K456: severe stale-track corruption exposes absolute task-performance sensitivity in the frozen 6v6 Share-Encoder controller
PRECOMMITTED_INTERPRETATION.noisy_or_non_monotone: no detectable severity-ordered effect at n=20
PRECOMMITTED_INTERPRETATION.z1_still_20_of_20_at_K6: no gross breakdown was observed under complete stale-opponent tracking on this exploratory block -- explicitly NOT 'the controller is robust'
PRECOMMITTED_INTERPRETATION.afterward: no significance chasing, no added seeds, no intermediate severity values

CLAIM_FENCE.does_not_measure: specialization robustness, latent-strategy robustness, or anything requiring Delta_A/Delta_B
CLAIM_FENCE.reason: the 6v6 sealed crossover did not establish joint specialization, and the Share-0 teacher diagnostic did not either
